posts.name: jfan999
posts.cooked: Hey folks, I just finished running the first issue of the starter kit and had a great time doing. In our post session talk about the system one of my players asked if rules for montage scenes were going to be more filled in the full book. Specifically they were asking if we would see any abilities, other than principles, that applied to non-combat situations when the full book was released. If not, does anyone have suggestions for keeping montage scenes engaging and challenging without everything just devolving into the players spamming overcome rolls?
